limitations: ASR disagreement can reflect recognizer errors; it is not a human naturalness or pronunciation rating.
All synthetic wording is retained. Some original pronunciations, including rare names, already required review.
Speaker similarity from original TTS selection does not measure this revised processing.
Every earnings-call version uses speech-free stationary texture because estimated word timestamps alone cannot verify speech-free gaps.
validation_scope: 111 source-PCM/timing checks, past-only acoustic calibration and zero-word background controls; all seven paired-ASR regressions enumerated with caveats. Human naturalness and exact speech accuracy are not certified.

first--authored-W4-2.note: Program/programme spelling changes; the question meaning and all required terms are retained.

expansion--ES-teletext.note: ASR adds Uh before Assistant. The wake word and complete teletext question remain present. Six tone/level controls reproduce the same recognizer difference; no claim of exact cue-first transcription.

expansion--ES-devices.note: DVD versus D V D is an acronym-tokenization difference; it does not change the intended devices.

expansion--MO-performance.note: Re-imaged versus reimaged changes tokenization; the earlier re-image/re-imaged and too/to ASR limitations remain.

expansion--MO-selection.note: Were versus are changes recognized tense. The request for the store-selection criterion remains intact; exact word accuracy is not claimed.

pilot--P-DH-cepheid.note: ASR duplicates the before quarterly. The shipment-target question and Cepheid comparison remain complete.

scale--TS3004d-slide-reasons.note: ASR changes slide to slight. All three no-EQ tone/level controls reproduce it; the unchanged source wording says slide-open. Keep this pronunciation/recognizer ambiguity visible for listening review rather than declaring a word-accuracy pass.
